name: TC-04-asset-create
description: TC-04.1: Create Asset with Full Details — validates CRUD and field persistence

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.1 — Asset List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Asset Management → Asset. The asset list shows all registered assets with their current lifecycle state, site, and criticality.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Opening screenshot for the Asset Management chapter.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.1 — New Asset Form
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to open the asset creation form. The form includes fields for description, asset class, site, department, manufacturer, and more.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the blank asset creation form with all field groups.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.1 — Fill Description
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "Test Motor 001 — E2E Lifecycle Test" into the Description field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.1 — Asset Created
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Create' to save the asset. The system assigns an auto-generated ID (e.g., A-00001) and sets the initial workflow state to 'Acquired'.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the auto-generated ID and initial state badge.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.1 — Asset Detail View
doc_metadata.caption: The asset detail page shows all fields organized in tabs. The workflow state badge in the header indicates the current lifecycle state. Use the workflow dropdown to transition the asset through its lifecycle.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Full page showing the saved asset with all sections.
